connector.name: Stremio MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Search, play, and control Stremio on Android TV over native ADB.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package stremio-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the netixc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANDROID_TV_HOST
env.description: Android TV IP address for playback and device control

env.name: TMDB_API_KEY
env.description: TMDB API key for title search

env.name: STREMIO_AUTH_KEY
env.description: Stremio account token for library reads and writes

env.name: ADB_PATH
env.description: Path to the native ADB executable
